# Luci Playback

A free local-in-browser player for Luci screen-memory frames and audio.

- Site: https://luci.luisliuchao.com/
- About: https://luci.luisliuchao.com/about.html
- Luci (Memories.ai): https://luci.memories.ai
- Source: https://github.com/luisliuchao/luci-playback
- Contact: mailto:luisliuchao@gmail.com
- Author: Liu Chao

## What it is

Luci Playback plays the frames and audio that Luci saved on the visitor's computer. Luci is the original local screen-memory app from Memories.ai. Luci Playback is an independent player for those local files. It is not the Luci app itself.

There is no login. Nothing is uploaded. The browser reads a folder the visitor picks. Encrypted `LUCISS01` frames are decrypted on the device with WebCrypto. The Luci Safe Storage password never leaves the computer. The browser keeps the unlock so a refresh does not ask again.

## How to use it

1. Open https://luci.luisliuchao.com
2. Click Choose folder.
3. Pick the Luci home folder, not the user folder:
   - macOS: `~/.luciMicrosoft` (Cmd+Shift+G in the picker, then paste that path)
   - Linux / Windows: `~/.luci`
4. If frames are encrypted, enter the Luci Safe Storage password. On a Mac, the unlock screen shows this command, which copies the password to the clipboard:

```
security find-generic-password -s "luci-electron Safe Storage" -w | pbcopy
```

Chrome refuses folders that contain system files. If the picker errors with a SecurityError about system files, the visitor picked too high (often the home folder). They should pick Luci home instead.

## Playback

Playback follows real capture time, not frame index. Frames are usually about five seconds apart. The scrub bar is the captured day. The clock shows `HH:MM:SS / HH:MM:SS`. Hover on the bar shows the time under the pointer.

If the Luci folder has microphone or system recordings, audio plays in sync with the current frame.

Keyboard: Space plays or pauses; arrows or `j`/`l` step one frame; `,`/`.` jump 10 seconds; Shift+arrows jump one minute; Home/End jump to the start or end of the day; `m` mutes. Speed is 1x–30x.

## Privacy

- Frames, audio, `.dbkey`, and the Safe Storage password stay on the visitor's computer.
- The site does not upload files.
- The browser may remember the folder handle and unlock in IndexedDB on that device.
- Reset saved path and password from the More menu.

## Related names

Luci, Luci Playback, Memories.ai, screen memory, local player, Rewind alternative, Safe Storage, LUCISS01, ~/.luciMicrosoft, ~/.luci.
